messages:

Cc: procurement-eu@evergreenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding and PO process for Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking my call earlier. Were preparing to add Redwood Inference as an approved vendor for two Evergreen legal entities (Evergreen Health US, tax ID 12-3456789; Evergreen Health EU, VAT DE123456789). Before we kick off, can you confirm the following so AP can map invoices correctly?

- Can Redwood be registered under two separate remit profiles so we can route US invoices to the US bank and EU invoices to the EU account?
- What fields do you need on our PO for automated matching? We currently have PO number, billing legal entity, cost center, and invoice contact.
- Do you accept split invoices (one invoice per legal entity) or a single invoice with a split-line attachment?

We need your AP onboarding packet and any vendor forms to complete our supplier registry. Ive attached a sample PO and the reg form format Evergreen uses. Goal is to have Redwood able to invoice by April 1.

Attachments: sample_purchase_order.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Sam Bennett

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and PO process for Redwood

Hi Sam — thanks, and great to connect. We can support what you described but need a few items to make the onboarding smooth:

1) Legal entity confirmation: Please confirm the exact legal name you want on invoices for each entity (well create two vendor records if needed).
2) Tax docs: For the US entity we need a completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US residency). For the EU entity well need the VAT registration certificate (or EU VAT self-cert) and the legal entitys registered address.
3) Remit options: We can maintain two remit destinations. If you prefer a single vendor ID and two remit sub-profiles, we can do that — let us know which is easier for your AP.
4) Matching fields: Our AP system expects PO number (field PO_NUMBER), billing_legal_entity, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), invoice_total, and invoice_pdf_name. For automated match we recommend PO in the subject and PO_NUMBER in the PDF body.

Ill ask Rachel to send our AP onboarding packet and a remit authorization PDF for signature. Karthik is looped in in case you want to discuss EDI/CSV PO integrations.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: AP intake packet + remit authorization (Redwood vendor setup)

Hi Sam — attaching our standard AP onboarding packet and the bank remit authorization form. A couple of notes to help Evergreens AP team complete the registry:

- Invoice naming convention: please ask suppliers to name PDFs as INV-[customer]-[PO_NUMBER]-[YYYYMMDD].pdf (e.g., INV-EVG-12345-20270331.pdf). This ensures our ingestion service attaches the PDF to the PO.
- PO mapping: map your PO number to our PO_NUMBER field and include the billing legal entity as EXACT_LEGAL_NAME.
- Split-invoice support: Redwood can issue separate invoices per legal entity (preferred) or a single consolidated invoice with split line items. If you choose consolidated invoices, include a CSV attachment with the line split using column entity_code to allow automated allocation.
- VAT handling (EU): for reverse-charge invoices, include the buyer VAT ID on the invoice header and add the line: "Reverse charge - Art. 194". Redwood will not collect VAT for EU-to-EU B2B reverse charge transactions where a valid buyer VAT ID is provided.
- Early-pay / discount codes: we can accept early-pay via your AP portal; if you plan to enroll in early payment, include the header EP-OFFER-ID so we can apply the discount at settlement.

Attachments: AP_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF), remit_authorization_form.pdf (PDF)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4892

When you reply, please attach the signed remit form and completed vendor fields (legal name, tax IDs, remit preference, invoice contact email). If youd prefer DocuSign for signatures, I can send the envelope.

Thanks — Rachel Kim
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@evergreenhealth.com>

Subject: Re: AP intake packet + remit authorization (Redwood vendor setup)

Hi Rachel/Marissa — attached is the completed vendor registry form and the signed remit authorization (PDFs). A couple of quick questions as we fill in Evergreens supplier portal:

1) For EU invoices: do you want us to post a single invoice to Redwood EU and include the whole order, or should we create one PO per legal entity and expect two invoices? Our procurement system can only create one PO per purchase by default; we can deploy a split-PO process but it adds lead time.

2) VAT/Reverse-charge: if we submit the buyer VAT ID, will Redwood mark the invoice as reverse-charge-ready so our tax team can clear it without VAT being remitted to Redwood?

3) Early-pay: were evaluating an early-pay program for suppliers. If Evergreen enrolls and routes payment through your early-pay code, what is the settlement timing and who do we contact to confirm discount calculations?

Attachments: completed_vendor_form.pdf

Thanks — Sam
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AP intake packet + remit authorization (Redwood vendor setup)

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the completed form. Confirming next steps and answers below so your tax and AP teams have a single reference:

1) Preferred flow for split-billing: to minimize changes on your side we recommend creating one PO but letting Redwood submit two invoices (one per legal entity) tied to the same PO number. Each invoice will include the PO_NUMBER in the header and will be suffixed with the legal entity code: INV-EVG-12345-US.pdf and INV-EVG-12345-EU.pdf. Your portals matching should still bind on PO_NUMBER; if your system cannot accept two invoices against one PO, we can instead request two POs.

2) VAT / reverse charge: yes — if you include the buyer VAT ID on the invoice header and in the vendor portal field buyer_vat_id, Redwood will generate the EU invoice with the "Reverse charge - Art. 194" note and zero VAT. We will also populate the invoice XML (when used) with the reverseChargeIndicator flagged for automated consumption. Please have your tax team email taxops@evergreenhealth.com to confirm the buyer VAT ID format if youre using non-standard registration numbers.

3) Early-pay handling: if Evergreen enrolls in early-pay, include the header EP-OFFER-ID on the invoice submission. Settlement timing depends on the offer but typically funds are disbursed T+5 after invoice acceptance. We will send a confirmation email to payments@evergreenhealth.com with the discount amount and effective settlement date prior to funding.

4) Vendor record: weve created a vendor record for "Redwood Inference Inc." and added a second remit sub-profile for the EU legal entity. Enrollment confirmation is attached. You should see the vendor in your portal tomorrow under supplier name Redwood Inference Inc. / vendor ID RDW-29871.

Attachments: enrollment-confirmation.pdf

If youd like a short 20-minute walkthrough with our AP intake specialist to test an invoice and confirm the XML/CSV mapping, Karthik and I are available next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations (Customer Payments)
Redwood Inference
